sn12.22:2.1: “Stripped of patchwork” is ironic given that this is, in fact, a patchwork discourse.
sn12.22:2.2: This sentence is not entirely coherent. The opening phrase is normally followed by “those who”, while _alameva_ follows the accusative, not the locative.
